items.title: Simply supported beam, uniform load
items.description: Bending moment, shear and mid-span deflection of a simply supported beam under a uniform load: M = wL²/8, V = wL/2, δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI).
items.author: Alireza

items.title: Pad footing, eccentric load
items.description: Ground pressure under a rectangular pad footing with an axial load and a moment about one axis: e = M/N, σ = N/(B·L)·(1 ± 6e/L). Valid while the whole base is in compression (e ≤ L/6, σ_min ≥ 0). L is the length in the direction of the moment.
items.author: Alireza

items.title: Pad footing pressure
items.description: Bearing pressure under a pad footing.
items.author: Alireza

items.title: RC rectangular beam, bending reinforcement (EN 1992-1-1)
items.description: Tension reinforcement of a rectangular reinforced concrete section in bending, simplified rectangular stress block (EN 1992-1-1, γc 1.5, γs 1.15): K = M/(b·d²·fck), z = d·min(0.5 + √(0.25 − K/1.134), 0.95), As = M/(0.87·fyk·z). Valid for K ≤ 0.167 (no compression reinforcement needed).
items.author: Alireza

items.title: Steel column, flexural buckling (EN 1993-1-1)
items.description: Flexural buckling resistance of a steel column about one axis, EN 1993-1-1 6.3.1: Ncr = π²EI/Lcr², relative slenderness λ̄, reduction factor χ from the imperfection factor α of the buckling curve (a0 0.13, a 0.21, b 0.34, c 0.49, d 0.76), Nb,Rd = χ·A·fy/γM1. Example: HEB 200 about z (curve c), 4 m, S355.
items.author: Alireza

items.title: Concrete strength classes (EN 1992-1-1)
items.description: Concrete classes C12/15 to C90/105 from EN 1992-1-1 Table 3.1: fck, fck_cube, fcm, fctm, fctk005 (5% fractile) and Ecm. Example: Concrete("C30/37", "fck").
items.author: Alireza

items.title: HEA sections (EN 10365)
items.description: European wide flange beams HEA 100 to HEA 600: dimensions h, b, tw, tf, r and properties A, Iy, Wel_y, Wpl_y, i_y, Iz, Wel_z, Wpl_z, i_z and mass G, with units. Properties computed from the EN 10365 dimensions, including root fillets; within 0.2% of manufacturers' tables. Example: HEA("HEA 300", "Wpl_y").
items.author: Alireza

items.title: HEB sections (EN 10365)
items.description: European wide flange beams HEB 100 to HEB 600: dimensions h, b, tw, tf, r and properties A, Iy, Wel_y, Wpl_y, i_y, Iz, Wel_z, Wpl_z, i_z and mass G, with units. Properties computed from the EN 10365 dimensions, including root fillets; within 0.2% of manufacturers' tables. Example: HEB("HEB 300", "Wpl_y").
items.author: Alireza

items.title: IPE sections (EN 10365)
items.description: European I beams IPE 80 to IPE 600: dimensions h, b, tw, tf, r and properties A, Iy, Wel_y, Wpl_y, i_y, Iz, Wel_z, Wpl_z, i_z and mass G, with units. Properties computed from the EN 10365 dimensions, including root fillets; within 0.2% of manufacturers' tables. Example: IPE("IPE 300", "Wpl_y").
items.author: Alireza

items.title: Reinforcing bar areas
items.description: Reinforcing bars 6 to 40 mm: the area of 1 to 8 bars (A1 to A8) and the mass per metre G (7850 kg/m³). Example: Rebar(16, "A4") is the area of 4 bars of 16 mm.
items.author: Alireza

items.title: Structural steel grades (EN 1993-1-1)
items.description: Hot-rolled steel S235 to S450 (EN 10025-2) from EN 1993-1-1 Table 3.1: fy and fu for t up to 40 mm, fy_40_80 and fu_40_80 for 40 < t up to 80 mm, and E. Example: SteelGrade("S355", "fy").
items.author: Alireza
